name: APC TransSwap swaps inventory at the live APC/USDT spot quote
summary: The TransSwap proxy priced APC against MUSD from the APC/USDT PancakeSwap pair's live reserves and paid from its own inventory. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker pumped APC, swapped APC for MUSD at the inflated quote, dumped APC, swapped the MUSD back for more APC at the depressed quote and sold it.
notes: The proxy constructor selected implementation 0xc6fc79db and initialized the MUSD, pair, USDT and APC addresses in the same transaction; no upgrade or configuration change preceded the exploit. Of 367 swap calls before the 0x929ddb5d upgrade, only these two came from flash-loan contracts; the rest are EOA swaps.

Gross APC drained from the TransSwap inventory, each transaction valued at what the attacker realised: the APC/USDT pair's net USDT outflow, USDT at par. The MUSD legs net to zero and the attackers' own dump crashed APC, so spot-marking is not used.
